title: Implement a Vector Similarity Document Retriever for RAG
description: Compute cosine similarity between query embeddings and a collection of document embeddings to retrieve top-k documents.
problemStatement: Implement a Python function `retrieve_top_k(query_vec, doc_vecs, docs, k=2)` that returns the top-k most similar document strings based on cosine similarity. Cosine similarity = dot(q, d) / (norm(q) * norm(d)). Return the list of top-k document strings sorted in descending order of similarity score.
hints: Compute cosine similarity for each document vector.
Use np.argsort(similarities)[::-1][:k] to retrieve top indices.
expectedOutput: List of top-k retrieved document text strings
solutionCode:
import numpy as np

def retrieve_top_k(query_vec, doc_vecs, docs, k=2):
    q_norm = np.linalg.norm(query_vec)
    sims = []
    for d_vec in doc_vecs:
        d_norm = np.linalg.norm(d_vec)
        cos_sim = np.dot(query_vec, d_vec) / (q_norm * d_norm) if (q_norm * d_norm) > 0 else 0.0
        sims.append(cos_sim)
    top_indices = np.argsort(sims)[::-1][:k]
    return [docs[idx] for idx in top_indices]

q = np.array([0.8, 0.2, 0.0])
docs_vecs = [
    np.array([0.1, 0.9, 0.1]),
    np.array([0.85, 0.15, 0.0]),
    np.array([0.7, 0.3, 0.1])
]
docs = ['Cats and dogs', 'Neural network optimization', 'Gradient descent algorithm']
print(retrieve_top_k(q, docs_vecs, docs, k=2))
